title: Bootstrap test infrastructure (vitest)
description: Add `vitest` as a devDependency. Create `vitest.config.mjs` with `testMatch: ["tests/**/*.test.mjs"]`, coverage thresholds `scripts/ >= 80%`, `lib/ >= 90%` (when `lib/` exists). Add npm scripts: `test`, `test:watch`, `test:coverage`. Update `package.json` `engines.node >= 20`. Verify `npx vitest run` exits 0 on empty test set.
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run` exits 0 (no tests yet, no failure)
